title: Japan in a Nutshell Grand Circuit
alt: Thatched farmhouses below Mount Fuji at Iyashi no Sato, Japan
transport: Coaches, trains and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station, with free time in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Kawaguchiko
stops.subtitle: Kawaguchiko to Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Lakeside resort with Mount Fuji across the water on a clear day

activities.name: Lake Kawaguchi boat ride
activities.description: A cruise out onto the lake, with the mountain reflected in the water when the cloud lifts.

activities.name: Mount Fuji fifth station
activities.description: Up the mountain road to the fifth station at 2,300 metres, where the treeline ends and the climbing trail begins.

program.name: Kawaguchiko
program.description: A lakeside night below Mount Fuji, with a boat ride on the lake and the drive up to the fifth station.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto to Shiraito falls and Nagoya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel opposite Kyoto station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Iyashi no Sato Nenba village
activities.match: Visit to Iyashi No Sato Nenba
activities.description: A rebuilt village of thatched farmhouses below Mount Fuji, now craft workshops where you can try dyeing or pottery.

activities.name: Watanabe house museum and the water mill
activities.description: An old silk merchant's house kept as it was, and the traditional wooden water mill still turning beside the stream.

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Two nights by Kyoto station, reached through the thatched village and water mill of the Fuji foothills, with a full guided day.

stops.name: Nagano
stops.subtitle: Nagano to Tsumago and Matsumoto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel attached to Nagano station

activities.name: Tsumago post town
activities.description: A preserved post town on the old Nakasendo road, where the wooden inns and shopfronts look much as travellers found them.

activities.name: Matsumoto crow castle
activities.description: The black keep they call the crow castle, standing on its moat with the Alps behind it, an original from the sixteenth century.

program.name: Nagano
program.description: A night in Nagano, reached through Tsumago on the old post road and the black keep at Matsumoto.

stops.name: Ikaho
stops.subtitle: Ikaho to the monkey park, Kusatsu and Nikko
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Ryokan room · 3★ · Traditional inn at Ikaho hot spring, with tatami rooms and shared baths

activities.name: Zenkoji temple
activities.description: Nagano's great temple, home to what is said to be the first Buddhist statue brought to Japan, kept hidden behind the altar.

activities.name: Snow monkey park
activities.description: The hot spring at Jigokudani where wild macaques sit chest deep in the steaming water, often with snow on their heads.

activities.name: Kusatsu hot spring town
activities.description: Free time in Kusatsu, where the hot water runs down wooden channels through the middle of the town square.

activities.name: Nikko sightseeing tour
activities.description: The lacquered Toshogu shrine in its cedar forest, the Shinkyo bridge and the Kegon falls before the drive back to Tokyo.

program.name: Ikaho
program.description: A ryokan night at a hot spring, with Zenkoji, the snow monkeys and Kusatsu on the way, and Nikko on the final day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Eight days, five towns and eleven included visits. It is the fullest circuit we sell at this price.
expert.tip: Two nights in Kyoto is the breather in the middle. Use the free evening in Gion rather than planning anything.

summary: Eight days on a full circuit: Tokyo, a lakeside night below Mount Fuji with a boat ride and the fifth station, two nights in Kyoto reached through the thatched village of Iyashi no Sato, Tsumago and Matsumoto castle, then the snow monkeys, a ryokan night and Nikko.
included: Included: 7 nights across five towns with daily breakfast, including a lakeside resort below Mount Fuji and a ryokan at Ikaho; coaches and trains throughout; guided sightseeing in Tokyo, Kyoto and Nikko; Lake Kawaguchi boat ride and the Mount Fuji fifth station; Iyashi no Sato Nenba, the Watanabe house museum and the water mill; free time at Tsumago and Kusatsu; Matsumoto crow castle; Zenkoji temple and the snow monkey park.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
